chronology.event: Shiki declines to answer Lee's question whether battle is primarily fighting opponent's body. Lee respectfully stops probing, apologizes briefly, Guy says nothing.
Gaara vs Neji Chunin Exam tournament final begins. Neji's Byakugan perceives Gaara's sand's semi-autonomous defense.
Neji breaches sand shield, momentarily strikes Gaara's shoulder with gentle fist; Gaara is hurt, sand armor cracks. Gaara begins escalating.

Gaara confines Neji's legs and abdomen in sand, causing serious leg injuries and impaired breathing. Genma orders stop as Neji loses consciousness, Gaara releases. Gaara is declared tournament champion. Neji alive, breathing independently, unconscious with visible right leg deformity compatible with fracture and possible left leg injury, medics evacuate. No more detailed permanent diagnosis yet.

Genma recognizes concern, sends subordinate. Grey-cloaked figure closes door near corridor where Kabuto went earlier; no evidence yet of figure's identity or plan. Lee leaves to check on Neji, Guy with medics.

Shiki remains standing/seated unspecified at participants' stand, sees arena, medical access and some west service corridor. Stadium begins orderly audience dispersal, ceremony not yet held. Player has next choice.
